opening: I have an ulcer on my tongue.
Because of it I've become dehydrated.
Before the ulcer formed, my tongue turned blue.
Before coming here I was first treated with trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole.
After that I was given acyclovir.

opening.text: My tongue hurts and I have an ulcer on it. It also hurts to swallow, and because of that I've become dehydrated. These symptoms started two weeks ago. Before the ulcer formed, my tongue turned blue. I was first treated with trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, then amoxicillin-clavulanate, and after that acyclovir.
